summary: Deployment validation of MSSP SOC Analytics Dashboard with local Ollama qwen2.5:1.5b. All critical checks passed: health OK, login 200, copilot/status ready:true & model=qwen2.5:1.5b, /api/copilot/chat returned source='hf-llm' and model='qwen2.5:1.5b' (confirmed via direct curl AND end-to-end UI flow through IRIS panel), /api/export/pptx returned HTTP 200 with valid PPTX (PK zip signature, ~25MB), executive overview shows LIVE data (data_status='live', 8 incidents, SLA 100%, MTTR 3.93h, health 50, risk 0.8). All 7 persona routes (executive, soc-manager, client, detection, threat-intel, soar, comparison, settings) loaded without any page or console errors while logged in. IRIS launcher/panel/input/send-btn testids all functional.

PPTX endpoint is /api/export/pptx (not /api/exports/pptx). Executive endpoint is /api/dashboard/executive.
